messages.system.title: System
messages.system.background: The game pauses in the background. Progress is saved automatically in this browser.
messages.system.updateSaveError: Could not save. The update has not started: {{error}}
messages.system.offlineDone: Offline files saved. You can play in this language without an internet connection.
messages.system.offlineError: Download incomplete. Click again to resume: {{error}}
messages.system.offlineUnsupported: This browser does not support offline caching.
messages.assist.title: Auto-use Settings
messages.assist.intro: Settings apply to this character after saving.
messages.assist.potions: Regular potions wait until recovery ends. Sun and Strong Sun Potions share a 4-second cooldown; other instant potions have at least 1 second between automatic uses. Only potions that restore the matching resource are used.
messages.assist.swords: Learned sword skills are prepared when ready and when you have enough MP, then released on your next attack. When both are prepared, Blazing Sword is used first, followed by Flaming Sword. Paused while dead or mounted.
messages.update.title: Update Game
messages.update.timeout: The download timed out. Please try again.
messages.update.incomplete: The update download did not finish.
messages.update.unsupported: This browser cannot update offline files.
messages.update.activationTimeout: Applying the update timed out. Please try again.
messages.update.done: Update complete. Returning to the game…
messages.update.error: Update incomplete: {{error}} Your saves are still stored in this browser. You can return to the game.
messages.system.offlineStateRunning: Saved {{done}} / {{total}}; reused {{reused}}, downloaded {{downloaded}}. Continues outside this panel.
messages.system.offlineStateComplete: Offline resources ready: {{done}} / {{total}}. Saved resources remain available after reopening.
messages.system.offlineStatePaused: Saved {{done}} / {{total}}. Resume the download; connection failures retry when online.
messages.system.offlineStateElsewhere: Another game tab is downloading. Progress updates automatically.
messages.system.offlineStateError: Offline cache could not finish: {{error}}. Completed files are retained.
messages.system.offlineStateReady: Cached {{done}} / {{total}}. Only missing resources will download.
